title: Chana masala (chickpea curry) with rice
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Finely chop the onion, garlic, ginger and chilli, briefly toast the cumin in the oil and fry the vegetables for 6 minutes until golden.
Add the turmeric and garam masala, then the tomatoes and rinsed chickpeas and simmer for 15 minutes.
Season with salt and serve with soya yoghurt, coriander and rice.
